The '''Oasis City Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in [[Oasis City]] on [[Darvannis]]. During the [[Galactic War]], most of the spaceport was converted into a display area for the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and weapons sold by [[Olok]] the Shadow.
